response: The stand relocation will destroy my income. I cannot afford to travel 3km extra every day. Compensation of 5000 rupees is not enough for even one month.

I support road widening if they give us a designated hawking zone nearby. Not too far from the main road.
Nobody consulted us. The ward office people don't come here.
Road widening is long overdue. Traffic is impossible. I support this proposal fully.

Good for property values. But the drainage plan is not mentioned anywhere in the document. That's a serious gap.

Rent will go up if the area improves. Landlords always find a way. We will be pushed out.
The water connection disruption during construction is my main concern. We already get water only 2 hours a day.
I don't understand the document. Too much legal language. Can someone explain in Hindi?
Construction workers will bring outsiders. Safety at night will get worse for women in our building.

I cannot walk far. If the bus stop moves because of road work, I will be completely stranded.
Noise and dust from construction will be very bad for health. I have breathing problems already.
The budget allocation in section 3 seems underestimated. This kind of work cost double in Bandra last year.
Nobody told us this was happening. I found out from this app.
Five thousand for relocation allowance is an insult. We will protest.

I support this. The road is dangerous for children going to school. Please do it fast.
When is the public hearing? I want to attend and raise the drainage issue formally.

I am not against progress but please think about old people and disabled people in the design.
We need a meeting with the ward officer before any decision. This affects 8000 families directly.
